title: Women's Health
need: Hormones, cycles or menopause, with time to talk them through
summary: Gynaecology and menopause care from consultants who give first appointments a full hour, from heavy periods and endometriosis to perimenopause and HRT.
intro: Women's health problems are often common and rarely trivial: heavy or painful periods, perimenopausal symptoms that begin years before periods stop, questions before trying to conceive, or an ultrasound result that needs explaining. We see them in one place, with gynaecology, endocrinology and ultrasound working together.

faqs.q: Do I need blood tests to diagnose perimenopause?
faqs.a: Usually not over the age of 45 with typical symptoms; the diagnosis comes from your history. Blood tests can help in younger women, or where the picture is unclear.
If it is right for you, yes, after talking through benefits, risks and alternatives in light of your own history. We then review how you are doing at three months.
